architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Shared UI in src/components/. Neubrutalism CSS via Tailwind. Router: React Router. State: React Context. No Redux. Minimal deps. Mobile-first. No SSR.

tickets.title: Build Jastip order form page (src/pages/JastipOrderForm.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML to React. Form fields: item name, quantity, destination, notes. Submit button. Validation: required fields. Error states. Mobile layout only. Neubrutalism styling via Tailwind.
acceptance_criteria: Form render match Stitch screen pixel-perfect
Submit button disabled during API call
Tailwind classes match Neubrutalism design (bold borders, high contrast, no rounded corners)

tickets.title: Build Jastip home screen (src/pages/JastipHome.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML. Hero banner. Trip catalog grid. Search bar. Category filters. Neubrutalism styling via Tailwind. Mobile layout only.
acceptance_criteria: Screen render match Stitch screen pixel-perfect
Trip cards link to catalog pages

tickets.title: Build Jastip catalog pages (src/pages/JastipCatalogJepangTrip1.jsx, src/pages/JastipCatalogJepangTrip2.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert both Stitch screens. Trip details. Item grid. Pagination. Neubrutalism styling via Tailwind. Mobile layout only.
acceptance_criteria: Both screens render match Stitch pixel-perfect
Item cards link to order form

tickets.title: Build 30Space showcase pages (src/pages/ThirtySpaceShowcase.jsx)
tickets.source_screen: thirtyspace_table_showcase, thirtyspace_sidebar_showcase, thirtyspace_loader_showcase, thirtyspace_badge_showcase, thirtyspace_button_showcase, thirtyspace_component_showcase_inputs
tickets.description: Combine all Stitch showcase screens into single page. Tabs for each component type. Neubrutalism styling via Tailwind. Mobile-first. Interactive demos for inputs, buttons.
acceptance_criteria: All component types render match Stitch

tickets.title: Build 30Space hero section (src/pages/ThirtySpaceHero.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML. Hero banner. CTA buttons. Neubrutalism styling via Tailwind. Mobile-first.
acceptance_criteria: CTA buttons link to correct pages

tickets.title: Build login/register page (src/pages/LoginRegister.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML. Login form. Register form. Toggle between forms. Validation: email format, password length. Error states. Neubrutalism styling via Tailwind. Mobile layout only.

tickets.title: Build 404 page (src/pages/NotFound.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML. 404 message. Navigation links. Neubrutalism styling via Tailwind. Mobile-first.

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Create app shell. Navigation bar. React Router setup. Route config for all pages. Neubrutalism styling via Tailwind. Mobile-first. No desktop layout.
